THE CARD TABLE · FIRST-PERSON PLAY
PILEHEAD

Rules · how to play

Get rid of all your cards. Numbers 1–10 are ordinary ranks with no abilities; play an equal or higher number on the pile, or any action card. You may lay matching numbers or identical action cards together, with a special card's effect applied once per group. If you have no legal move, pick up the entire pile. Keep three cards in hand while the draw stock lasts. Then play your face-up cards, followed by your blind face-down cards.

RESET · next number may be any number.
GHOST · transparent; restriction stays.
UNDER ↓4 · next number must be 1–4.
SKIP · next player loses a turn.
BURN · play the dedicated BURN card to burn the whole pile (including BURN) and immediately play again.
DUMP · burn DUMP itself; the next player collects only the existing pile, then you play again.
SLAM! · finish four equal numbers on the pile, or slam all four copies of one number from your hand onto a nonempty pile, even out of turn; burn and take the next turn.
SNAP! · if the card you draw immediately after playing a number has the same number, throw that newly drawn card onto the pile before anyone else plays. This does not steal the next turn unless the pile burns.
LAST-HAND COMBO · when the draw stock is empty and your final hand card matches a face-up card, you can place both together.

Start with three face-down cards, three face-up and three in hand. Before playing, you can exchange cards between your hand and face-up row. The final player with cards is the PILEHEAD.
